summary: Bump the changelog-derived working version to 0.4.10 and place the staged BMC detection and host UI fixes under that version. The pool VLAN host-uplink mapping remains a plan, not a released capability.

guide.reason: Current development-version labels now identify 0.4.10; the version bump changes no operator steps.

api.reason: The staged BMC probe contract is unchanged; its new POST /api/v1/pools/{id}/members/{host_id}/bmc-probe operation is first introduced in working version 0.4.10, so only its introduction metadata changes.

roadmap.reason: Version metadata and release notes do not change a milestone gate.

state.reason: A working-version label introduces no durable resource or setting.
